overall_notes: Well-constructed thin slate with solid devigging across 3–6 books and morning timestamps. Five overs rest on strong recent form (60–90% L10 hit rates) with contextual injury support (Duren out for Jenkins, WAS thin for Pritchard). The single under (Gordon) is volume-driven with explicit non-blowout reasoning. L2 (Davis 1.5 AST) and L5 (Marshall 2.5 AST) are marginal on form alone (both 50% hit rate) but appropriately derated at the board's longest odds, so no hard veto issues surface.

Pricing reflects this softness; no hard line-mismatch or stale-price error, but conditional risk on Washington's health.

Last game barely cleared at 2 SOG with lower end of TOI range, suggesting some role instability, but perfect hit streak and upgraded role context are solid. Only three books but above the veto threshold (n_books ≥ 2); no line-mismatch. Adequate coverage for thin slate.
